## 1.Packages and data

```{r packages}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(e1071)
library(pROC)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
set.seed(1213)
```

```{r data}
macro <- read_csv("../data/processed/fred_md_macro_clean_final.csv", show_col_types=FALSE) %>%
  mutate(sasdate=as.Date(sasdate)) %>% arrange(sasdate)
macro_fin <- read_csv("../data/processed/fred_md_macro_financial_clean_final.csv", show_col_types=FALSE) %>%
  mutate(sasdate=as.Date(sasdate)) %>% arrange(sasdate)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(macro$sasdate), !anyDuplicated(macro_fin$sasdate))
stopifnot(identical(macro$sasdate, macro_fin$sasdate))
stopifnot(all(macro$USREC %in% c(0,1)), all(macro_fin$USREC %in% c(0,1)))
month_index <- function(x) as.integer(format(x, "%Y"))*12L + as.integer(format(x, "%m"))
stopifnot(all(diff(month_index(macro$sasdate)) == 1L))
```

## 2.Setting Target: any recession in the next h months

```{r targets}
create_targets <- function(df) {
  df <- arrange(df, sasdate)
  for (h in c(3,6,12)) {
    y <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
      if (i + h > nrow(df)) return(NA_integer_)
      future <- df$USREC[(i+1):(i+h)]
      if (anyNA(future)) return(NA_integer_)
      as.integer(any(future == 1))
    }, integer(1))
    df[[paste0("Y_", h)]] <- y
  }
  df
}
macro <- create_targets(macro)
macro_fin <- create_targets(macro_fin)
```

## 3.Gaussian Naive Bayes

```{r nb-functions}
fit_nb <- function(train, predictors, epsilon=1e-6) {
  x <- train[, predictors, drop=FALSE]
  if (!all(vapply(x, is.numeric, logical(1)))) stop("Predictors must be numeric")
  valid <- predictors[vapply(x, function(z) {
    z <- z[is.finite(z)]
    length(z) >= 2 && length(unique(z)) > 1
  }, logical(1))]
  if (!length(valid)) stop("No usable predictors")
  x <- x[, valid, drop=FALSE]
  medians <- vapply(x, function(z) median(z[is.finite(z)]), numeric(1))
  for (v in valid) x[[v]][!is.finite(x[[v]])] <- medians[[v]]
  y <- factor(train$target, levels=c(0,1))
  if (length(unique(y)) < 2) stop("Both classes required for NB training")
  x$target <- y
  fit <- e1071::naiveBayes(target ~ ., data=x, eps=epsilon, threshold=epsilon)
  list(fit=fit, predictors=valid, medians=medians)
}

predict_nb <- function(fitted, newdata) {
  x <- newdata[, fitted$predictors, drop=FALSE]
  for (v in fitted$predictors) x[[v]][!is.finite(x[[v]])] <- fitted$medians[[v]]
  as.numeric(predict(fitted$fit, newdata=x, type="raw")[, "1"])
}

forecast_nb <- function(df, horizon, refit_every=1L, test_start=as.Date("1986-01-01")) {
  df <- arrange(df, sasdate)
  target <- paste0("Y_", horizon)
  predictors <- setdiff(names(df), c("sasdate", "USREC", "Y_3", "Y_6", "Y_12"))
  test_indices <- which(df$sasdate >= test_start & !is.na(df[[target]]))
  if (!length(test_indices)) stop("No test observations")
  output <- vector("list", length(test_indices))
  fitted <- NULL
  for (j in seq_along(test_indices)) {
    i <- test_indices[j]
    if ((j-1L) %% refit_every == 0L) {
      last_train <- i - horizon - 1L
      if (last_train < 1L) stop("Insufficient history")
      train <- df[seq_len(last_train), , drop=FALSE] %>%
        filter(!is.na(.data[[target]])) %>%
        mutate(target=.data[[target]])
      fitted <- fit_nb(train, predictors)
    }
    output[[j]] <- data.frame(
      sasdate=df$sasdate[i], horizon=horizon,
      actual=df[[target]][i], predicted_prob=predict_nb(fitted, df[i,,drop=FALSE])
    )
  }
  bind_rows(output)
}
```

## 4.Run all six configurations

```{r forecasts, cache=TRUE}
datasets <- list(Macro=macro, Macro_Financial=macro_fin)
horizons <- c(3,6,12)
all_forecasts <- list()
for (dataset_name in names(datasets)) {
  for (h in horizons) {
    cat("Running Naive Bayes:", dataset_name, h, "months\n")
    res <- forecast_nb(datasets[[dataset_name]], horizon=h, refit_every=1L)
    res$dataset <- dataset_name
    res$model <- "Naive Bayes"
    all_forecasts[[paste(dataset_name,h,sep="_")]] <- res
  }
}
nb_forecast_results <- bind_rows(all_forecasts)
```

```{r forecast-check}
nb_forecast_results %>%
  group_by(dataset, horizon) %>%
  summarise(n_forecasts=n(), unique_dates=n_distinct(sasdate),
            min_prob=min(predicted_prob), max_prob=max(predicted_prob), .groups="drop") %>%
  kable(digits=3)
```

## 5.Evaluation: AUC, F1, balanced accuracy, Brier

```{r evaluate}
evaluate_forecasts <- function(df, threshold=0.5) {
  actual <- df$actual
  prob <- df$predicted_prob
  predicted <- as.integer(prob >= threshold)
  TP <- sum(predicted==1 & actual==1)
  TN <- sum(predicted==0 & actual==0)
  FP <- sum(predicted==1 & actual==0)
  FN <- sum(predicted==0 & actual==1)
  precision <- if (TP+FP==0) 0 else TP/(TP+FP)
  recall <- if (TP+FN==0) NA_real_ else TP/(TP+FN)
  specificity <- if (TN+FP==0) NA_real_ else TN/(TN+FP)
  f1 <- if (is.na(recall)) NA_real_ else if (precision+recall==0) 0 else 2*precision*recall/(precision+recall)
  balanced_accuracy <- (recall+specificity)/2
  brier <- mean((actual-prob)^2)
  auc_value <- if (length(unique(actual))<2) NA_real_ else
    as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(actual, prob, levels=c(0,1), direction="<", quiet=TRUE)))
  data.frame(AUC=auc_value, F1=f1, Balanced_Accuracy=balanced_accuracy, Brier=brier)
}
nb_evaluation_results <- nb_forecast_results %>%
  group_by(dataset,horizon,model) %>%
  group_modify(~evaluate_forecasts(.x)) %>% ungroup()
kable(nb_evaluation_results, digits=3)
```

## 6.Incremental value of financial indicators

```{r financial-comparison}
nb_financial_comparison <- nb_evaluation_results %>%
  select(dataset,horizon,AUC,F1,Balanced_Accuracy,Brier) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=dataset, values_from=c(AUC,F1,Balanced_Accuracy,Brier)) %>%
  mutate(AUC_gain=AUC_Macro_Financial-AUC_Macro,
         F1_gain=F1_Macro_Financial-F1_Macro,
         Balanced_Accuracy_gain=Balanced_Accuracy_Macro_Financial-Balanced_Accuracy_Macro,
         Brier_improvement=Brier_Macro-Brier_Macro_Financial) %>%
  select(horizon,AUC_gain,F1_gain,Balanced_Accuracy_gain,Brier_improvement)
kable(nb_financial_comparison,digits=3)
```

## 7.Paired moving-block bootstrap for AUC gain

```{r auc-bootstrap, cache=TRUE}
block_bootstrap_auc_gain <- function(actual, prob_macro, prob_fin, block_length=24L, n_boot=1000L) {
  n <- length(actual)
  if (n < block_length) stop("Block length exceeds test sample")
  n_blocks <- ceiling(n/block_length)
  gains <- replicate(n_boot, {
    starts <- sample.int(n-block_length+1L, n_blocks, replace=TRUE)
    idx <- unlist(lapply(starts, function(s) seq.int(s,s+block_length-1L)))[seq_len(n)]
    y <- actual[idx]
    if (length(unique(y))<2) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(y,prob_fin[idx],levels=c(0,1),direction="<",quiet=TRUE))) -
        as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(y,prob_macro[idx],levels=c(0,1),direction="<",quiet=TRUE)))
    }
  })
  observed <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(actual,prob_fin,levels=c(0,1),direction="<",quiet=TRUE))) -
    as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(actual,prob_macro,levels=c(0,1),direction="<",quiet=TRUE)))
  data.frame(AUC_gain=observed,
             CI_lower=unname(quantile(gains,.025,na.rm=TRUE)),
             CI_upper=unname(quantile(gains,.975,na.rm=TRUE)),
             valid_resamples=sum(!is.na(gains)))
}

paired <- nb_forecast_results %>%
  select(sasdate,horizon,dataset,actual,predicted_prob) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=dataset,values_from=predicted_prob) %>%
  arrange(horizon,sasdate)
stopifnot(!anyNA(paired$Macro), !anyNA(paired$Macro_Financial))
set.seed(1213)
nb_auc_gain_ci <- paired %>%
  group_by(horizon) %>%
  group_modify(~block_bootstrap_auc_gain(.x$actual,.x$Macro,.x$Macro_Financial)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(significant=CI_lower>0 | CI_upper<0)
kable(nb_auc_gain_ci,digits=3)
```

## 8.ROC curves

```{r roc-curves, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
for (h in horizons) {
  subset <- nb_forecast_results %>% filter(horizon==h)
  curves <- lapply(split(subset,subset$dataset), function(d) {
    pROC::roc(d$actual,d$predicted_prob,levels=c(0,1),direction="<",quiet=TRUE)
  })
  print(pROC::ggroc(curves, legacy.axes=TRUE) +
          geom_abline(slope=1,intercept=0,linetype="dashed",color="grey50") +
          labs(title=paste0("Naive Bayes ROC: ",h,"-month horizon"),
               x="False positive rate",y="True positive rate",color="Dataset") +
          theme_minimal())
}
```
